# Packages added to Hermes's own environment, which cannot install them itself:
# edge-tts for its default text-to-speech provider (Edge), ddgs for its
# DuckDuckGo web search provider, and faster-whisper for local speech to text
# (voice messages; PyAV 15, since 16+ dropped an open() option faster-whisper
# passes). Only what Hermes lacks, hash-pinned and resolved against the pinned
# Hermes image's own versions.
